content.text: This check method is used only to determine whether or not the idle HC/CO complies with regulations.

items: (c) All pipes and hoses of air intake system connected

content.text: All vacuum hoses for EGR systems, etc. should be properly connected.

items: (f) EFI system wiring connectors fully plugged
(i) Tachometer and HC/CO meter calibrated and at hand
RACE ENGINE AT 2,500 RPM FOR ABOUT 2 MINUTES
INSERT TESTING PROBE OF HC/CO METER INTO TAILPIPE AT LEAST 40 cm (1.3 ft)

MEASURE HC/CO CONCENTRATION AT IDLE
Wait at least one minute before measuring to allow the concentration to stabilize.
Complete the measuring within three minutes.
If the HC/CO concentration does not conform to your regulations, see the table below for possible causes.

rows:
1. Faulty ignition:
   • Incorrect timing
   • Fouled, shorted or improperly gapped plugs
   • Open or crossed ignition wires
   • Cracked distributor cap
2. Faulty EGR system:
   • EGR valve
3. Leaky exhaust valves
4. Leaky cylinder

1. Vacuum leak:
   • Vacuum hose
   • Intake manifold
2. Lean mixture causing misfire
